title: The Authorization *Gap*
dek: Five AI coding tools with the same trust-boundary flaw. A contractor's Claude agent on the Pentagon network for two months. Canada's $1.14B equity stake in Cohere. China sets frontier export thresholds at 10^26 FLOPs. CS enrollment down 18% in two years.

stories.label: AI coding tools with the same trust-boundary flaw
stories.headline: Five separate dev teams independently built the same architectural mistake.

stories.label: input per million tokens, 47% the cost of closed frontier
stories.headline: A trillion-parameter MoE at 47% the token cost of closed frontier models.

stories.label: operating systems, 1 unreleased model
stories.headline: A model capable of building working exploits for five OSes, one deployment decision away.

stories.label: valuation, largest Canadian startup financing ever
stories.headline: The first G7 government to buy equity in a frontier AI lab, with job and compute conditions attached.

stories.short: SpaceX: Anthropic is 34.5% of Q3 revenue
stories.label: of SpaceX Q3 revenue from one AI training contract
stories.headline: Anthropic is the launch company's largest customer. The contract is finite.

stories.short: DOE: $5B nuclear loan, pre-sold to hyperscalers
stories.label: federal loan for 1.1GW already contracted to Google, Amazon, Meta
stories.headline: Federal energy loans are routing stable baseload power to hyperscaler data centers.

stories.short: Accenture agent on DOD network: 2 months
stories.label: months undetected on a secure Pentagon network
stories.headline: The monitoring systems that would catch this were not designed to look for it.

stories.short: China: frontier AI export threshold at 10^26 FLOPs
stories.label: FLOPs training compute triggers export restriction
stories.headline: China drew the line just above where its current open models land.

stories.short: CS enrollment down 18% in two years
stories.label: graduate CS enrollment over two years
stories.headline: The labor-market repricing arrived two to three years ahead of the policy response.

still_signal: Every institution that touched AI this week was running on assumptions about control that capability had already outpaced. The authorization gap is not a patch. It is the condition that has to be designed around.
